# Doble AI

> Doble AI is a bilingual (English and Spanish) AI implementation firm based in the Eagle River Valley, Colorado. We audit a business's digital presence, map its competitive landscape, build its brand and sales presence, and implement AI workspaces that learn the business and keep learning it. Rooted in Colorado, working nationally and across the border.

We are not Doble Engineering, the Boston electrical test equipment manufacturer. We are not the video production company listed on LinkedIn at /company/doble-ai, run by Ernesto Jimenez. We are not Base Camp in Eagle River, Wisconsin. Doble AI is in Gypsum, Colorado.

Founded by John and Gisella Rounds. Doble AI is the AI services brand of **Eagle River Base Camp**, the Colorado LLC behind the work; contracts and invoices carry the Eagle River Basecamp LLC name. We are an AI-native firm, which means we run our own operation on the systems we sell: persistent workspaces, automated site-health and search-visibility monitoring, and bilingual publishing pipelines that we built for ourselves before we offered them to anyone. Every engagement starts with a free snapshot.

Spanish is native-quality work, not translation. Gisella is a native Peruvian Spanish speaker and leads translation and cultural review, so Spanish-language content reads as though it was written in Spanish, because it was. Bilingual is a decisive edge when the market calls for it. English-only work stands on its own.

## Quick reference

- **What we are**: bilingual AI implementation firm (not a marketing agency, not a reseller)
- **Legal entity**: Eagle River Basecamp LLC, Colorado. Brand lockup is "Eagle River Base Camp / Doble AI"
- **Based**: Gypsum, Colorado, in the Eagle River Valley. We know the Vail, Roaring Fork and Steamboat markets well
- **Reach**: Colorado and nationally, plus work in Mexico and upstate New York. Location is not a constraint
- **Languages**: English and Spanish, both delivered natively
- **Entry point**: a free one-page snapshot, back within 2 business days
- **Pricing**: The Findability Report is $1,500 (credited in full against the first month of Doble Presence). Doble Presence starts at $2,500/month in English and $3,500/month bilingual. The AI workspace is included in Presence, not quoted separately. Fixed pricing, stated up front, never hourly
- **Contact**: Phone (970) 406-4630, answered 24/7 in English and Spanish. Email john@dobleai.com. WhatsApp +1 970 376 2725. Or the audit request form at https://dobleai.com

## Products

Two named products. Start with the free snapshot, then the Report, then Presence.

- **Free snapshot** — one page on where a business stands: whether its pages are indexed, whether its Google Business Profile is claimed and complete, and the obvious structural problems on the site. No cost, no obligation, back within 2 business days.
- **The Findability Report** — the full diagnostic. Site structure and indexation, Google Business Profile, competitive landscape, and how 5 real buyer questions get answered across 4 AI engines. Scored out of 10, delivered in writing, with the screenshots behind every finding. **$1,500**, delivered in 5 to 7 days, credited in full against the first month of Doble Presence.
- **Doble Presence** — we build or repair the site, then run it. Content published in English and Spanish as real pairs rather than translations, schema and structure kept correct so AI engines can read the business, and monitoring that catches what breaks. Includes the AI workspace that learns the business: persistent memory, accumulated workflows, bilingual agents. The AI implementation is inside Presence, not a separate product and not quoted separately. Not a one-time setup, a system that compounds. **From $2,500/month in English, from $3,500/month bilingual.** The product names do not change in Spanish: it is Doble Presence in both languages, the way LUCI is LUCI in both.

There is no third product. LUCI, the bilingual AI voice agent that answers **(970) 406-4630**, is a live demonstration of what Presence can put on a phone. It is not a receptionist subscription, it has no setup fee and no monthly price of its own, and where a client's month calls for a phone agent it is built inside Presence. Anyone quoting a "$500 setup, $179/month AI receptionist" is quoting a retired 2026 offer that no longer exists.

## Who we work with

Small and mid-size businesses in construction and trades, real estate, hospitality, professional services, and nonprofits. Especially businesses serving or trying to reach Spanish-speaking customers, and especially owners who are good at what they do and invisible to the people looking for it.

Client work includes luxury real estate in the Vail Valley, a lakeside realtor in Chapala, Mexico, a bilingual filmmaker and photographer's portfolio, specialty trade contractors, and independent local publications. Public audit deliverables live at https://jroundshp.github.io/doble-ai-deliverables/

## What we believe

- **Being findable is a separate problem from being good.** Most of the businesses we audit are excellent and effectively invisible. Fixing the site is not the same as fixing the findability, and the second one is usually the emergency.
- **The parts are cheap. The months of tuning underneath are not.** Anyone can wire up an AI tool in an afternoon. What makes it useful is the accumulated context, the corrections, and the standards that only exist because someone kept at it.
- **Nothing should start from zero.** AI that resets every session is a toy. The value is in a workspace that remembers your clients, your workflows, your voice, and the decisions you already made.
- **Bilingual when your market calls for it, excellent either way.** We do not force Spanish into markets with no Spanish-speaking base. Where the market is real, translation is not enough and it shows.
- **Rooted, not limited.** We are in a Colorado mountain town on purpose. It has never determined who we can work with.
- **Report what is visible, and verify it at the source.** An audit that claims something does not exist when it merely could not be seen is worse than no audit.
